      "text": "# Holiday Schedule of the Bank\n\nThe Bank's offices in Japan -- Head Office, branches, and local offices -- are closed on Saturdays, Sundays, and the following days:\n\n1. National holidays (as defined in Act No. 178 of 1948) and Substitute holidays\n2. December 31 to January 3\n\n## National and other holidays observed by the Bank\n\n### 2026\n\nTable: Holiday Schedule of the Bank 2025| Month | Date |\n| --- | --- |\n| January | 1, 2, 3, 12 |\n| February | 11, 23, |\n| March | 20 |\n| April | 29 |\n| May | 3, 4, 5, 6 |\n| June | -- |\n| July | 20 |\n| August | 11 |\n| September | 21, 22, 23 |\n| October | 12 |\n| November | 3, 23 |\n| December | 31 |\n\n### 2027\n\nTable: Holiday Schedule of the Bank 2026| Month | Date |\n| --- | --- |\n| January | 1, 2, 3, 11 |\n| February | 11, 23 |\n| March | 21, 22 |\n| April | 29 |\n| May | 3, 4, 5 |\n| June | -- |\n| July | 19 |\n| August | 11 |\n| September | 20, 23 |\n| October | 11 |\n| November | 3, 23 |\n| December | 31 |\n\n* Note: National holidays and observances are subject to change.",
